descriptionEn: A commercial unit is offered for sale on Rruga Gjergj Fishta, Fushë Kosovë.

The unit is located in a dynamic commercial hub, very close to AlTrade (formerly Baumarket), inside the ALTRADE – Linda 8 building, with immediate access to the main road Nëna Terezë. The area offers high visibility, constant footfall and strong development potential for any business activity.

The space has a total area of 81.02m² on the ground floor, organised as an open space with one bathroom, and regular documentation with an ownership certificate. There is an option to expand by 64.58m² + 39.45m², as needed, with direct access to the main road and ample parking near the building.
This unit offers high visibility, a flexible structure and expansion options, making it an ideal investment with growth potential and long-term stability.
